effects: The signer sends exactly `assets` USDC to the vault (safeTransferFrom caller -> vault in ERC4626._deposit).
The vault mints gtUSDC shares to `receiver`; the share count comes from the exchange rate in storage (convertToShares, rounded down).
The vault supplies the USDC to Morpho markets and may mint fee shares to the fee recipient; neither changes what the signer pays.
formats.shown: Intent 'Deposit' with the USDC amount, a fixed 'Share ticker: gtUSDC' line and the address that receives the shares.

findings.title: deposit does not show how many gtUSDC shares the receiver gets; the count depends on the vault rate in storage.
findings.evidence: MetaMorpho.deposit: `shares = _convertToSharesWithTotals(assets, totalSupply(), newTotalAssets, Math.Rounding.Floor);` The descriptor shows only `Share ticker` = $.metadata.constants.vaultTicker.
findings.fix: None possible in the descriptor. The share amount is not in calldata and the function has no minimum-shares parameter.

findings.title: deposit intent 'Deposit' does not name the asset or the vault shares received.
findings.evidence: descriptor deposit format: `"intent": "Deposit"`; the asset and shares appear only in fields.
findings.fix: Change the intent to "Deposit USDC for gtUSDC shares" and add an interpolatedIntent such as "Deposit {assets} for gtUSDC to {receiver}".

effects: The vault mints exactly `shares` gtUSDC to `receiver`.
The signer pays USDC to the vault; the amount is convertToAssets(shares) rounded up, taken from the exchange rate in storage.
The vault supplies the USDC to Morpho and may mint fee shares to the fee recipient.
formats.shown: Intent 'Mint' with 'Deposit asset: USDC' (ticker only), the gtUSDC share amount and the share receiver.

findings.title: mint does not show how much USDC leaves the signer; the vault computes it from storage.
findings.evidence: MetaMorpho.mint: `assets = _convertToAssetsWithTotals(shares, totalSupply(), newTotalAssets, Math.Rounding.Ceil); _deposit(_msgSender(), receiver, assets, shares);` Descriptor field 'Deposit asset' is the raw constant `underlyingTicker` with no amount.
findings.fix: None possible: the amount is not in calldata and there is no maximum-assets parameter. The wallet allowance bounds the payment.

findings.title: mint intent 'Mint' does not say that the signer pays USDC for the shares.
findings.evidence: descriptor mint format: `"intent": "Mint"`; the USDC payment shows only as a field 'Deposit asset' = 'USDC' with no amount.
findings.fix: Change the intent to "Pay USDC to mint gtUSDC shares" and add an interpolatedIntent "Mint {shares} for {receiver}, paid in USDC".

formats.key: withdraw(uint256 assets, address receiver, address owner)
effects: The vault sends exactly `assets` USDC to `receiver` (safeTransfer in ERC4626._withdraw).
The vault burns gtUSDC shares from `owner`; the count is convertToShares(assets) rounded up, from storage.
If the caller is not `owner`, the call spends the owner's gtUSDC allowance to the caller by the burned share count.
formats.shown: Intent 'Withdraw' with 'Withdraw exactly' USDC amount, the 'To' receiver and the 'Owner' whose shares are burned.

findings.title: withdraw does not show how many gtUSDC shares the owner burns; the count comes from storage.
findings.evidence: MetaMorpho.withdraw: `shares = _convertToSharesWithTotals(assets, totalSupply(), newTotalAssets, Math.Rounding.Ceil);` No field shows shares.
findings.fix: None possible: the share count is not in calldata and there is no maximum-shares parameter.

findings.title: withdraw intent 'Withdraw' does not say that gtUSDC shares burn to release USDC.
findings.evidence: descriptor withdraw format: `"intent": "Withdraw"`; no line names gtUSDC shares as the asset that leaves the owner.
findings.fix: Change the intent to "Withdraw USDC by burning gtUSDC shares" and add an interpolatedIntent "Withdraw {assets} to {receiver} from {owner}".

formats.key: redeem(uint256 shares, address receiver, address owner)
effects: The vault burns exactly `shares` gtUSDC from `owner` (the signer in case 0).
The vault sends USDC to `receiver`; the amount is convertToAssets(shares) rounded down, from storage.
If the caller is not `owner`, the call spends the owner's gtUSDC allowance to the caller by `shares`.
formats.shown: Intent 'Redeem' with the gtUSDC share amount, the 'To' receiver and the 'Owner'; nothing names USDC as the asset received.

findings.title: redeem never names USDC as the asset the receiver gets; mint shows the underlying ticker, redeem does not.
findings.evidence: Case 0: signer receives 94488.349772 USDC (signer 'in'); screen shows only 'Shares to redeem', 'To', 'Owner'. ERC4626._withdraw: `SafeERC20.safeTransfer(_asset, receiver, assets);` Reader: 'Which token is paid out; it is probably USDC but not stated'.
findings.fix: Add a field {"label": "Receive asset", "format": "raw", "value": "$.metadata.constants.underlyingTicker"} and change the intent to "Redeem gtUSDC shares for USDC".

findings.title: redeem does not show the USDC amount received; the vault computes it from storage.
findings.evidence: MetaMorpho.redeem: `assets = _convertToAssetsWithTotals(shares, totalSupply(), newTotalAssets, Math.Rounding.Floor);` Case 0: 94488349772 USDC arrived, no amount on screen.
findings.fix: None possible: the amount is not in calldata and there is no minimum-assets parameter.

findings.title: redeem intent 'Redeem' does not name the shares burned or the asset received.
findings.fix: Change the intent to "Redeem gtUSDC shares for USDC" and add an interpolatedIntent "Redeem {shares} for USDC to {receiver}".

cases.notes: gtUSDC 85050.25 out is shown exactly. USDC 94488.35 in: the screen names neither the asset nor the amount; the reader guessed USDC with no amount.
